title: Word Representations, Autoregressive Language Models & Subword Tokenization
description: Hands-on implementation covering continuous word representations, autoregressive neural language modeling, and subword tokenization algorithms. Detailed specifications and starter repository will be released by the teaching team.
deliverables: Experimental comparison report and theoretical analysis.

title: Transformers & Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT / LoRA)
description: Hands-on implementation of Transformer multi-head attention and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA / QLoRA) on open-weight language models. Detailed specifications will be released by the teaching team.
deliverables: PyTorch Transformer modules and LoRA adapter code.
Fine-tuning logs, checkpoint weights, and evaluation report.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Reasoning (CoT) & Model Alignment (DPO)
description: Hands-on implementation of dense/hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Chain-of-Thought reasoning verification, and preference alignment via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Detailed specifications will be released by the teaching team.
deliverables: RAG pipeline implementation and DPO alignment code.
Evaluation results on benchmark QA datasets and technical report.

title: Capstone Research & Applied LLM Systems Project
description: Open-ended graduate Master's research project in small teams (1–3 members). Topics encompass novel alignment methods, specialized reasoning agents, multimodal modeling, model compression, or Persian/Multilingual NLP benchmarks. Guidelines and milestones will be announced by the instructor.
deliverables: Final Codebase, Model Artifacts, and IEEE/ACL format Research Report.
Oral Presentation & Poster Defense in Final Sessions (POST1 & POST2 in Week 15).
